config.statistical_scope: Randomized repeated clocks use the same seeded data. Clock repetitions are not independent statistical episodes.
config.timing_scope: Serial warmed single-thread elapsed/cpu costs, not worst-case deadlines. Stream timers exclude data generation and estimator construction and include all corrections, buffer handling, actions, reports and variance fits. Pilot clocks may share the host and are engineering checks only.
config.memory_scope: Exact live persistent NumPy array bytes and separate tracemalloc peak; native BLAS/LAPACK workspaces and process RSS excluded.
config.rank_scope: Native complex rank one and real codimension one only. Physical contact remains n=3; other real dimensions are integration/cost fixtures.
config.precision_scope: Native first-moment/normalizer truncation, independent precision agreement, second moments, and tails have separate flags.
